assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to correlate symptoms with arrhythmic events and guide further management.
CPT code 93247 represents a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study.
CPT code 93247 is supported by I47.1, I48.0, and I49.9.
The denial of medical necessity under CO-197 does not reflect the documented clinical need described in the indication note.
